enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Open eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs off bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Lift toilet lid. Urinate. Flush toilet. Lower toilet lid. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Rinse toothbrush. Put toothbrush back. Pick up towel. Wet towel. Wipe face. Rinse towel. Wring towel. Hang towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and gathering personal items
enriched_activities.desc: Remove pajamas. Put on work shirt. Put on work trousers. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Pick up keys. Pick up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, bread, milk. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Fry eggs. Toast bread. Take out plate. Put eggs on plate. Put bread on plate. Pour milk into glass. Drink milk. Eat eggs and bread. Turn off stove. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Wait for water to boil. Pour water into mug. Add coffee. Stir coffee. Drink coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up breakfast dishes and packing a lunch container
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food scraps into bin. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Start dishwasher. Take out lunch container. Open refrigerator. Take out food items. Put food into container. Close container. Put container in bag. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital by bus/train (no EV use needed, so no conflict with Member 2's ElectricVehicle)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Get off train. Walk to hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist, assessing and treating patients on the ward and in the gym
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Greet colleagues. Review patient notes. Walk to patient room. Assess patient mobility. Demonstrate exercises. Assist patient with exercises. Monitor patient progress. Write treatment notes. Walk to gym. Set up equipment. Guide patient through exercises. Adjust equipment. Record observations. Coordinate with nurse. Walk back to ward. Update patient charts.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Buy lunch. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Talk with colleagues. Clear tray. Return tray. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing physiotherapy sessions, writing patient notes and coordinating with the care team
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Conduct physiotherapy session. Assist patient with walking. Demonstrate exercises. Monitor patient. Write notes in computer. Discuss patient care with team. Attend team meeting. Update patient records. Walk to gym. Set up equipment. Guide patient through exercises. Adjust equipment. Record observations. Coordinate with nurse. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital by bus/train (no EV use needed)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to train station. Wait for train. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off train. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Find seat. Sit down. Get off bus. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner using the induction cooker and range hood
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on range hood. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish meal. Stand up. Scrape plate into bin. Rinse plate. Load dishwasher. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Shift position. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put down phone. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review clinical notes and read physiotherapy material under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Log in. Open clinical notes. Read notes. Type notes. Scroll. Open physiotherapy article. Read article. Highlight text. Take notes. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing a light stretching and mobility routine on the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Lay out exercise mat. Sit on mat. Stretch arms forward. Stretch legs. Bend forward. Hold stretch. Sit up. Lie on back. Lift legs. Lower legs. Turn to side. Stretch. Turn to other side. Stretch. Stand up. Roll up mat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and drying off
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Hang towel. Turn off bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting out clothes for tomorrow and checking the phone before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out trousers. Lay clothes on chair. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Browse internet. Put phone on charger. Plug in charger. Get into bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to other side. Pull blanket. Sleep. Breathe deeply. Sleep.
